name: PM Awas Yojana (Gramin)
benefit: ₹1,20,000 for house construction in plains, ₹1,30,000 in hilly areas

roadmap.title: Gather Documents
roadmap.description: Collect Aadhaar, BPL Ration Card, Bank Passbook, and Land Documents.

roadmap.title: Visit Gram Panchayat
roadmap.description: Go to your Gram Panchayat office to collect the PMAY-G application form.

roadmap.title: Submit Application
roadmap.description: Fill the form and submit it along with your documents. Collect your receipt.

roadmap.title: Verification
roadmap.description: Authorities will verify your current housing situation and land documents.

roadmap.title: Track Status
roadmap.description: Use your application number on pmayg.nic.in to track approval.

common_rejections: Applicant already owns a pucca house.
Income exceeds the maximum limit.
Land documents are not clear or not in the applicant's name.
tips: Ensure your bank account is Aadhaar-seeded for direct benefit transfer.
Keep multiple photocopies of your land documents.

name: PM Awas Yojana (Urban)
benefit: Up to ₹2,67,000 subsidy on home loan for urban poor
benefit_hindi: शहरी गरीबों के लिए ₹2,67,000 तक होम लोन सब्सिडी

roadmap.title: Select Property
roadmap.description: Finalize the urban property you wish to buy or construct.

roadmap.title: Approach Bank
roadmap.description: Visit a participating bank or housing finance company for a home loan.

roadmap.title: Apply for Subsidy
roadmap.description: Request the bank to apply for the PMAY Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) during loan processing.

roadmap.title: CNA Verification
roadmap.description: The bank sends your claim to the Central Nodal Agency (CNA) for verification.

roadmap.title: Subsidy Credited
roadmap.description: Once approved, the subsidy is credited to your loan account, reducing your EMI.

common_rejections: Applicant or family member already owns a pucca house in India.
Income falls outside the specified EWS/LIG/MIG brackets.
Property location is outside the statutory town limits.
tips: Apply in the name of the female head of the household to increase approval chances.
Confirm with your lender that they are registered under the PMAY CNA.

name: PM Jan Arogya Yojana (Ayushman Bharat)
benefit: ₹5,00,000 annual health insurance cover per family
benefit_hindi: ₹5,00,000 तक मुफ्त इलाज प्रति परिवार हर साल
apply_at_hindi: नजदीकी अस्पताल या जन सेवा केंद्र

roadmap.title: Check Eligibility
roadmap.description: Verify your name in the PMJAY beneficiary list online or via the 14555 helpline.

roadmap.title: Visit Kiosk
roadmap.description: Go to an empanelled hospital or a Common Service Centre (CSC) with your Aadhaar and Ration Card.

roadmap.title: e-KYC Verification
roadmap.description: Complete fingerprint or OTP-based e-KYC to verify your identity.

roadmap.title: Collect Golden Card
roadmap.description: Get your Ayushman Bharat Golden Card printed for future use.

roadmap.title: Avail Treatment
roadmap.description: Show the card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment up to ₹5 Lakhs.

common_rejections: Name not present in the SECC 2011 database or state ration list.
Biometric mismatch during e-KYC.
tips: Always carry your Golden Card when visiting hospitals.
Download the PMJAY app to locate nearby empanelled hospitals easily.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
benefit: Free LPG connection + ₹1,600 subsidy for refills
benefit_hindi: मुफ्त गैस कनेक्शन + ₹1,600 रिफिल सब्सिडी

roadmap.title: Gather Documents
roadmap.description: Collect Aadhaar, BPL Ration Card, Bank details, and passport photos of the female applicant.

roadmap.title: Visit Distributor
roadmap.description: Go to the nearest LPG distributor (Indane, HP, or Bharat Gas).

roadmap.title: Fill KYC Form
roadmap.description: Request and fill out the Ujjwala KYC form completely.

roadmap.title: Document Verification
roadmap.description: Submit documents. The agency will verify against the OMC deduplication system.

roadmap.title: Receive Connection
roadmap.description: Once cleared, you will receive the gas cylinder, regulator, and passbook.

common_rejections: Another active LPG connection exists at the same address.
Applicant is male (must be an adult woman).
tips: Link your mobile number to your consumer ID to easily book refills.
Keep the blue book/passbook safe for subsidy tracking.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
benefit: ₹6,000 per year directly in bank (3 installments of ₹2,000)
apply_at_hindi: पटवारी कार्यालय या जन सेवा केंद्र

roadmap.title: Prepare Records
roadmap.description: Get updated copies of your land records (Khasra/Khatauni) and bank details.

roadmap.title: Register Online / CSC
roadmap.description: Apply through the Farmer Corner on pmkisan.gov.in or visit a local CSC.

roadmap.title: State Verification
roadmap.description: State nodal officers will verify your land ownership and eligibility.

roadmap.title: Complete e-KYC
roadmap.description: Mandatory e-KYC must be completed on the portal to receive funds.

roadmap.title: Receive Installments
roadmap.description: ₹2,000 will be credited directly to your account every 4 months.

common_rejections: Name mismatch between Aadhaar and Bank Account.
Farmer pays income tax or holds an institutional land holding.
e-KYC is pending.
tips: Regularly check your status on the PM Kisan portal.
Ensure your bank account is actively seeded with your Aadhaar.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (Crop Insurance)
benefit: Crop insurance up to ₹2,00,000 per hectare
benefit_hindi: ₹2,00,000 प्रति हेक्टेयर तक फसल बीमा
apply_at_hindi: नजदीकी बैंक या जन सेवा केंद्र

roadmap.title: Get Sowing Certificate
roadmap.description: Obtain a sowing certificate from the village Patwari/Sarpanch.

roadmap.title: Apply at Bank/CSC
roadmap.description: Submit the application along with land and bank details before the cut-off date.

roadmap.title: Pay Premium
roadmap.description: Pay the nominal premium (1.5%-2% for Rabi/Kharif crops).

roadmap.title: Report Damage
roadmap.description: In case of crop loss, inform the insurance company or bank within 72 hours.

roadmap.title: Claim Settlement
roadmap.description: Compensation is credited directly to your bank account post damage assessment.

common_rejections: Application submitted after the seasonal cut-off date.
Mismatch in sown crop details and insured crop details.
tips: Download the Crop Insurance App to easily report damages.
Non-loanee farmers must actively apply; loanee farmers are usually auto-enrolled.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
benefit: Up to ₹3 lakh loan at 4% interest for farmers
benefit_hindi: किसानों के लिए 4% ब्याज पर ₹3 लाख तक का लोन

roadmap.title: Download Form
roadmap.description: Get the simple KCC form online or from your bank.

roadmap.title: Submit at Bank
roadmap.description: Submit form with land documents and Aadhaar to your bank branch.

roadmap.title: Limit Sanction
roadmap.description: The bank evaluates your land holding and crop pattern to set a credit limit.

roadmap.title: Card Issuance
roadmap.description: Receive your KCC ATM-enabled debit card.

roadmap.title: Utilize Funds
roadmap.description: Use funds for farming expenses. Repay promptly to get the 3% interest subvention.

common_rejections: Poor credit history or existing default on agricultural loans.
Insufficient land holdings to justify the requested limit.
tips: Repay the loan amount before the due date to enjoy an effective 4% interest rate.
You can combine KCC with PM Kisan for easier approval.

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor Loan)
benefit: ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 collateral-free loan with 7% interest subsidy
apply_at_hindi: नजदीकी बैंक या जन सेवा केंद्र

roadmap.title: Get Vendor ID
roadmap.description: Obtain a Certificate of Vending or ID card from the Urban Local Body (ULB).

roadmap.title: Apply Online
roadmap.description: Visit the SVANidhi portal or a CSC to fill out the loan application.

roadmap.title: Bank Processing
roadmap.description: Your chosen bank will review and process the collateral-free loan.

roadmap.title: Disbursement
roadmap.description: The initial loan of ₹10,000 is credited directly to your bank account.

roadmap.title: Repay for Higher Limit
roadmap.description: Repay on time to become eligible for ₹20,000 and subsequently ₹50,000 loans.

common_rejections: Lack of recognition as a vendor by the local municipality.
Aadhaar not linked to the provided mobile number.
tips: Use digital payments to get cashback rewards up to ₹100 per month.
Timely repayment ensures you get the 7% interest subsidy credited quarterly.

name: Mudra Loan (PMMY)
benefit: Loans up to ₹10 lakh for small businesses without collateral
benefit_hindi: छोटे व्यवसायों के लिए बिना गारंटी ₹10 लाख तक का लोन

roadmap.title: Prepare Business Plan
roadmap.description: Draft a simple document explaining your business model and required funds.

roadmap.title: Choose Loan Category
roadmap.description: Decide between Shishu (up to ₹50K), Kishore (₹50K-₹5L), or Tarun (₹5L-₹10L).

roadmap.title: Approach Lender
roadmap.description: Visit a commercial bank, RRB, or NBFC with your application and documents.

roadmap.title: Bank Appraisal
roadmap.description: The lender assesses your business plan and credit history.

roadmap.title: Receive Funds
roadmap.description: Loan is disbursed, often along with a Mudra debit card for working capital.

common_rejections: Poor CIBIL score or past loan defaults.
Unclear or unviable business plan.
tips: For first-time borrowers, starting with the Shishu category has the highest approval rate.
Ensure you have proper quotations for machinery or equipment you intend to buy.

name: Stand Up India Loan
benefit: ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore loan for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs
benefit_hindi: SC/ST और महिला उद्यमियों के लिए ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक लोन

roadmap.title: Ensure Greenfield Project
roadmap.description: Confirm your business is a new enterprise (first-time venture) in manufacturing, services, or trading.

roadmap.title: Register on Portal
roadmap.description: Register on standupmitra.in to connect with lenders and handholding agencies.

roadmap.title: Submit Detailed Plan
roadmap.description: Provide a comprehensive project report to the chosen bank branch.

roadmap.title: Margin Money
roadmap.description: Arrange 10-15% of the project cost as margin money.

roadmap.title: Disbursement
roadmap.description: Funds are released in phases based on the project's implementation stage.

common_rejections: Business is not a greenfield (new) project.
Applicant cannot arrange the minimum margin money.
tips: If it's a partnership, at least 51% shareholding must be held by an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur.
Seek help from Stand-Up Mitra handholding agencies to draft your project report.

name: Scholarship for SC Students
benefit: ₹3,500 to ₹12,000 per year for education (Pre + Post Matric)

roadmap.title: Collect Certificates
roadmap.description: Obtain valid Caste and Income certificates from the Tehsildar.

roadmap.title: Register on NSP
roadmap.description: Create a profile on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

roadmap.title: Fill Application
roadmap.description: Select the correct Pre/Post Matric scheme and fill academic details.

roadmap.title: Institute Verification
roadmap.description: Submit a hard copy to your school/college for online verification.

roadmap.title: Fund Transfer
roadmap.description: Amount is credited via DBT to your Aadhaar-linked bank account.

common_rejections: Income certificate is older than 6 months or exceeds limits.
School/College fails to verify the application before the deadline.
tips: Double-check your bank account number and IFSC code before submitting.
Apply early to avoid last-minute portal crashes.

name: Scholarship for ST Students
benefit: ₹3,500 to ₹12,000 per year for tribal students
benefit_hindi: जनजातीय छात्रों के लिए ₹3,500 से ₹12,000 प्रति वर्ष

roadmap.title: Collect Certificates
roadmap.description: Obtain a valid ST Caste Certificate and Income proof.

roadmap.title: Register Online
roadmap.description: Register as a student on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

roadmap.title: Submit Details
roadmap.description: Enter fee receipts, academic scores, and upload documents.

roadmap.title: School Verification
roadmap.description: The institution verifies your bona fide student status.

roadmap.title: Direct Transfer
roadmap.description: The scholarship amount is sent directly to your bank account.

common_rejections: Caste certificate format is not recognized by the state.
Bank account is inactive or not seeded with Aadhaar.
tips: Keep fee receipts safe; you need to upload them for post-matric scholarships.
Ensure the spelling of your name matches exactly across Aadhaar, bank, and school records.

name: OBC Scholarship
benefit: ₹3,000 to ₹10,000 per year for OBC students

roadmap.title: Get OBC & Income Certs
roadmap.description: Ensure you have a recent non-creamy layer OBC certificate and income proof.

roadmap.title: NSP Portal Entry
roadmap.description: Log into scholarships.gov.in and select the state/central OBC scheme.

roadmap.title: Complete Form
roadmap.description: Fill out educational history and bank details securely.

roadmap.title: Institutional Check
roadmap.description: Notify your school/college nodal officer to approve the application online.

roadmap.title: Disbursement
roadmap.description: Funds are dispersed annually upon state level approval.

common_rejections: Applicant falls under the Creamy Layer.
Previous year attendance is below the required threshold.
tips: Renew your application every year; it does not carry over automatically.
Check if your state portal has a separate application process from the central NSP.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
benefit: Educational support and protection for girl children
benefit_hindi: बालिकाओं के लिए शिक्षा सहायता और सुरक्षा

roadmap.title: Birth Registration
roadmap.description: Ensure the girl child's birth is officially registered.

roadmap.title: Visit Anganwadi
roadmap.description: Approach local Anganwadi worker for scheme enrollment forms.

roadmap.title: Open Bank Account
roadmap.description: Open a bank/post office account in the name of the girl child.

roadmap.title: Submit Documents
roadmap.description: Provide birth certificate and parent ID to the District Women & Child Development office.

roadmap.title: Avail Benefits
roadmap.description: Receive periodic educational incentives and health checkup support.

common_rejections: Failure to immunize the child as per the mandatory schedule.
Child drops out of formal schooling.
tips: Often paired with Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana for financial benefits.
Maintain school attendance above 75% to ensure continued support.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: 8.2% interest savings scheme for girl child education and marriage
benefit_hindi: बालिका शिक्षा और विवाह के लिए 8.2% ब्याज बचत योजना

roadmap.title: Collect Documents
roadmap.description: Get the girl child's birth certificate and parents' KYC documents.

roadmap.title: Visit Branch
roadmap.description: Go to a Post Office or an authorized commercial bank.

roadmap.title: Fill Account Form
roadmap.description: Fill the SSY account opening form (Form-1).

roadmap.title: Initial Deposit
roadmap.description: Make a minimum initial deposit of ₹250 to activate the account.

roadmap.title: Maintain Account
roadmap.description: Deposit at least ₹250 annually. Withdrawals permitted after age 18 for education.

common_rejections: Girl child is older than 10 years at the time of opening.
Parents trying to open a third account (max 2 allowed, unless twins).
tips: Set up a standing instruction in your bank to ensure the minimum yearly deposit is met.
Contributions qualify for tax deduction under Section 80C.

name: Maternity Benefit Programme (PMMVY)
benefit: ₹5,000 cash for first pregnancy (in 3 installments)
benefit_hindi: पहली बार माँ बनने पर ₹5,000 (3 किस्तों में)

roadmap.title: Register Pregnancy
roadmap.description: Register the pregnancy at an Anganwadi within 150 days of LMP.

roadmap.title: Get MCP Card
roadmap.description: Obtain the Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card.

roadmap.title: First Installment
roadmap.description: Submit Form 1-A to get ₹1,000 after pregnancy registration.

roadmap.title: Second Installment
roadmap.description: Submit Form 1-B to get ₹2,000 after completing one ANC (after 6 months).

roadmap.title: Third Installment
roadmap.description: Submit Form 1-C to get ₹2,000 after childbirth and first cycle of immunizations.

common_rejections: Applicant is already a regular employee of Central/State Gov or PSUs.
Delay in registration beyond the permitted 150 days.
tips: Keep the MCP card extremely safe as it tracks your eligibility for all installments.
The scheme is specifically for the first living child.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
benefit: ₹600-₹1,400 for institutional delivery
benefit_hindi: अस्पताल में प्रसव के लिए ₹600-₹1,400
apply_at_hindi: सरकारी अस्पताल या प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्र

roadmap.title: Connect with ASHA
roadmap.description: Identify your local ASHA worker during pregnancy.

roadmap.title: Regular Checkups
roadmap.description: Ensure you undergo at least three antenatal check-ups (ANC).

roadmap.title: Institutional Delivery
roadmap.description: Deliver the baby at a government hospital or accredited private institution.

roadmap.title: Submit Details
roadmap.description: Provide bank details and JSY card to the hospital authorities post-delivery.

roadmap.title: Cash Transfer
roadmap.description: The incentive amount will be transferred directly to your bank account.

common_rejections: Delivery took place at home rather than a registered institution.
Applicant did not complete the required antenatal check-ups.
tips: ASHA workers get a separate incentive to help you, so utilize their guidance.
Carry all documents during the hospital admission for delivery.

name: MGNREGA (100 Days Work Guarantee)
benefit: 100 days guaranteed employment at ₹220-₹350/day (total ₹22,000-₹35,000)

roadmap.title: Register for Job Card
roadmap.description: Submit a verbal or written request for registration to your Gram Panchayat.

roadmap.title: Receive Job Card
roadmap.description: The Panchayat will issue a Job Card within 15 days of application.

roadmap.title: Demand Work
roadmap.description: Submit a formal request for work (specifying dates) to the Panchayat.

roadmap.title: Allocation
roadmap.description: You will be directed to a worksite within 5 km of your residence within 15 days.

roadmap.title: Payment
roadmap.description: Wages will be credited directly to your bank account within 15 days of work completion.

common_rejections: Applicant is not a local resident of the Gram Panchayat.
Household has already completed the 100-day limit for the financial year.
tips: If work is not provided within 15 days, you are entitled to an unemployment allowance.
Demand receipts for every application for work submitted to the Panchayat.

name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
benefit: Free skill training + ₹8,000 financial reward upon completion
benefit_hindi: मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण + पूरा होने पर ₹8,000 इनाम

roadmap.title: Find Training Centre
roadmap.description: Locate an authorized PMKVY training center near you online.

roadmap.title: Enroll in Course
roadmap.description: Choose a sector/skill and enroll with your Aadhaar and education docs.

roadmap.title: Complete Training
roadmap.description: Attend the short-term training (STT) and maintain biometric attendance.

roadmap.title: Assessment
roadmap.description: Pass the final assessment conducted by Sector Skill Councils.

roadmap.title: Certification & Reward
roadmap.description: Receive a certificate and reward money, plus placement assistance.

common_rejections: Insufficient biometric attendance during the course.
Failing the final practical/theory assessment.
tips: Choose a skill that has high demand in your local job market.
Take advantage of the Rozgar Melas (job fairs) organized for PMKVY certified candidates.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
benefit: ₹2,00,000 accident insurance for just ₹20/year

roadmap.title: Maintain Balance
roadmap.description: Ensure your savings account has at least ₹20 by the end of May.

roadmap.title: Fill Consent Form
roadmap.description: Visit your bank or use net banking to consent to auto-debit.

roadmap.title: Auto-Debit
roadmap.description: ₹20 is deducted annually between May 25 and May 31.

roadmap.title: Policy Active
roadmap.description: Insurance coverage runs from June 1 to May 31 of the next year.

roadmap.title: Claim Process
roadmap.description: In case of accident, nominee submits FIR and death/disability certificate to bank.

common_rejections: Insufficient bank balance during the auto-debit period.
Account holder turns 70 years old (coverage stops automatically).
tips: Always update your nominee details accurately in your bank account.
You can only subscribe to this scheme via one bank account, even if you hold multiple.

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
benefit: ₹2,00,000 life insurance for just ₹436/year

roadmap.title: Check Eligibility
roadmap.description: Confirm your age is between 18-50 and you have a savings account.

roadmap.title: Submit Form
roadmap.description: Fill the PMJJBY enrollment form at your bank or via mobile banking.

roadmap.title: Auto-Debit
roadmap.description: Ensure ₹436 is available for auto-debit before May 31 every year.

roadmap.title: Coverage Begins
roadmap.description: Risk cover begins 30 days after enrollment (except for accidents).

roadmap.title: Claim Process
roadmap.description: Nominee must approach the bank with death certificate within 30 days of death.

common_rejections: Auto-debit fails due to insufficient balance.
Death occurs within the first 30 days (lien period) due to natural causes.
tips: This is term life insurance; there is no maturity benefit if you survive.
Pair this with PMSBY (Accident insurance) for comprehensive cheap coverage.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
benefit: ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 monthly pension after age 60

roadmap.title: Decide Pension Amount
roadmap.description: Choose a guaranteed pension amount between ₹1,000 and ₹5,000.

roadmap.title: Submit Application
roadmap.description: Fill the APY form at your bank branch with Aadhaar details.

roadmap.title: Set Auto-Debit
roadmap.description: Set up monthly, quarterly, or half-yearly auto-debits.

roadmap.title: Consistent Saving
roadmap.description: Maintain balance for auto-debits until you reach 60 years of age.

roadmap.title: Receive Pension
roadmap.description: At age 60, submit a request to the bank to start receiving the monthly pension.

common_rejections: Applicant is an income tax payer (rules updated recently to exclude taxpayers).
Account deactivated due to continuous non-payment of contributions.
tips: Join as early as age 18 to keep your monthly contribution extremely low.
Spouse will receive the same pension after the subscriber's death.

name: Indira Gandhi Old Age Pension
benefit: ₹200-₹500 per month pension for elderly BPL
benefit_hindi: बीपीएल वृद्धों के लिए ₹200-₹500 मासिक पेंशन

roadmap.title: Gather Proofs
roadmap.description: Collect age proof (Voter ID/Aadhaar) and BPL Ration card.

roadmap.title: Submit Form
roadmap.description: Apply at the local Gram Panchayat or Municipal office.

roadmap.title: Verification
roadmap.description: Social welfare department verifies age and BPL status.

roadmap.title: Approval
roadmap.description: Upon approval, the name is added to the district pension list.

roadmap.title: Pension Disbursal
roadmap.description: Pension credited monthly directly to the bank/post office account.

common_rejections: Applicant is not strictly below the poverty line (BPL).
Age proof is invalid or shows age under 60.
tips: Pension amount jumps to ₹500/month automatically when the beneficiary crosses 80 years of age.
Keep the bank account active to prevent funds from bouncing back.

name: Indira Gandhi Widow Pension
benefit: ₹300 per month pension for BPL widows
benefit_hindi: बीपीएल विधवाओं के लिए ₹300 मासिक पेंशन

roadmap.title: Obtain Certificates
roadmap.description: Secure husband's death certificate and BPL card.

roadmap.title: Submit Application
roadmap.description: Apply at the Tehsil office or Gram Panchayat.

roadmap.title: Official Review
roadmap.description: The application is reviewed by the block development officer.

roadmap.title: Sanction
roadmap.description: Once sanctioned, an order is issued in the applicant's name.

roadmap.title: Direct Transfer
roadmap.description: ₹300 per month is credited into the widow's bank account.

common_rejections: Applicant remarries (which invalidates eligibility).
Age is below 40 years.
tips: Many states top-up this amount, so your actual monthly pension might be higher.
Ensure the death certificate clearly lists the applicant as the spouse.

name: Indira Gandhi Disability Pension
benefit: ₹300-₹500 per month for differently-abled persons
benefit_hindi: दिव्यांगजनों के लिए ₹300-₹500 मासिक पेंशन

roadmap.title: Get Medical Board Cert
roadmap.description: Obtain a severe/multiple disability certificate (80% or more) from a Govt Hospital.

roadmap.title: Submit Form
roadmap.description: Submit application with BPL proof to District Social Welfare office.

roadmap.title: Verification
roadmap.description: Authorities verify the extent of disability and BPL status.

roadmap.title: Approval
roadmap.description: Pension gets approved and linked to your bank account.

roadmap.title: Monthly Credit
roadmap.description: Receive monthly pension via Direct Benefit Transfer.

common_rejections: Disability level is less than 80%.
Applicant is not from a BPL household.
tips: Applying for a UDID (Unique Disability ID) card makes the process much smoother.
When the beneficiary turns 80, the pension converts to Old Age Pension.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme
benefit: ₹20,000 lump sum on death of primary breadwinner
benefit_hindi: मुख्य कमाने वाले की मृत्यु पर ₹20,000 एकमुश्त

roadmap.title: Obtain Death Certificate
roadmap.description: Get the death certificate of the primary breadwinner.

roadmap.title: Prepare Documents
roadmap.description: Compile BPL card, FIR (if unnatural death), and applicant's ID.

roadmap.title: Apply Promptly
roadmap.description: Submit the application to the local Tehsil/SDM office within 1 year of death.

roadmap.title: Field Verification
roadmap.description: An officer will visit to verify that the deceased was indeed the primary earner.

roadmap.title: Lump Sum Transfer
roadmap.description: ₹20,000 is credited as a one-time grant to the surviving head of family.

common_rejections: Application submitted more than 1 year after the death.
Deceased was over 59 years old at the time of death.
tips: Ensure the age of the deceased on the death certificate is between 18 and 59.
Do not delay; strict timelines apply to this bereavement scheme.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
benefit: Up to ₹3 lakh financial assistance for fishermen
benefit_hindi: मछुआरों के लिए ₹3 लाख तक की वित्तीय सहायता

roadmap.title: Register with Dept
roadmap.description: Ensure you are registered with the State Fisheries Department.

roadmap.title: Submit Project Proposal
roadmap.description: Draft a proposal (e.g., buying a boat, nets, or setting up a pond).

roadmap.title: Apply for Subsidy
roadmap.description: Submit application to the District Fisheries Officer.

roadmap.title: Approval & Financing
roadmap.description: Project gets approved; you may need to arrange a bank loan for the rest.

roadmap.title: Subsidy Release
roadmap.description: Subsidy (up to 40% for Gen, 60% for SC/ST/Women) is released post implementation.

common_rejections: Project proposal lacks technical feasibility.
Applicant lacks land/water body ownership or valid lease.
tips: Forming a cooperative or Self Help Group (SHG) significantly increases approval chances.
Subsidies are strictly back-ended, meaning you get them after purchasing the assets.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit: Free soil testing and recommendations for farmers
benefit_hindi: किसानों के लिए मुफ्त मिट्टी परीक्षण और सिफारिशें

roadmap.title: Sample Collection
roadmap.description: State officials collect soil samples from your farm grid.

roadmap.title: Lab Testing
roadmap.description: Sample is sent to testing lab for 12 parameters (N, P, K, etc.).

roadmap.title: Report Generation
roadmap.description: Lab creates a customized report for your specific land.

roadmap.title: Card Distribution
roadmap.description: The printed Soil Health Card is distributed to you via Panchayat/KVK.

roadmap.title: Apply Fertilizer
roadmap.description: Follow the card's recommendations to save money and improve yield.

common_rejections: Rarely rejected, but samples can be delayed if logistics fail.
tips: If officials haven't visited, you can take a sample yourself and submit it to a local KVK.
The card is renewed every 2 years to track soil improvement.

name: National Pension System (NPS)
benefit: Tax-free retirement savings with government contribution
benefit_hindi: सरकारी योगदान के साथ कर-मुक्त सेवानिवृत्ति बचत

roadmap.title: Choose POP
roadmap.description: Select a Point of Presence (bank/post office) or register online at eNPS.

roadmap.title: Fill Form & KYC
roadmap.description: Provide PAN and complete KYC to generate your PRAN (Permanent Retirement Account Number).

roadmap.title: Select Fund Manager
roadmap.description: Choose a Pension Fund Manager and investment choice (Auto or Active).

roadmap.title: Regular Contributions
roadmap.description: Deposit minimum ₹1,000 annually into your Tier-I account.

roadmap.title: Retirement Corpus
roadmap.description: At age 60, withdraw 60% tax-free and buy an annuity with the remaining 40%.

common_rejections: PAN card is not linked with Aadhaar.
Failing to make the minimum yearly contribution freezes the account.
tips: NPS offers an additional ₹50,000 tax deduction under section 80CCD(1B).
Choose 'Auto Choice' if you don't know how to allocate between Equity and Debt.

name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana
benefit: Guaranteed 7.4% annual pension for senior citizens
benefit_hindi: वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए 7.4% गारंटी मासिक पेंशन

roadmap.title: Decide Investment
roadmap.description: Decide lump-sum amount (up to ₹15 Lakh) based on the monthly pension needed.

roadmap.title: Visit LIC
roadmap.description: LIC of India is the sole operator; visit a branch or use their portal.

roadmap.title: Submit KYC
roadmap.description: Submit age proof and bank details for pension crediting.

roadmap.title: Pay Premium
roadmap.description: Pay the single premium lump-sum amount.

roadmap.title: Receive Returns
roadmap.description: Get guaranteed pension for 10 years, plus return of principal at the end.

common_rejections: Applicant is below 60 years of age.
Total investment exceeds the ₹15 Lakh cap per senior citizen.
tips: You can take a loan up to 75% of purchase price after 3 policy years.
This scheme's subscription window periodically closes, check current availability.

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
benefit: 5kg free food grains per person per month
benefit_hindi: प्रति व्यक्ति प्रति माह 5 किलो मुफ्त अनाज

roadmap.title: Link Aadhaar
roadmap.description: Ensure your Aadhaar is linked to your existing Ration Card.

roadmap.title: Check Allocation
roadmap.description: Verify your family's grain allocation online on the state PDS portal.

roadmap.title: Visit FPS
roadmap.description: Go to your local Fair Price Shop (Ration shop).

roadmap.title: Biometric Auth
roadmap.description: Provide fingerprint on the e-PoS machine to authenticate.

roadmap.title: Collect Ration
roadmap.description: Receive 5kg free grain per family member directly from the dealer.

common_rejections: Ration card is inactive due to long periods of non-use.
Thumbprint fails to register on the e-PoS machine.
tips: Under 'One Nation One Ration Card', you can claim this from any state in India.
Demand a printed receipt from the e-PoS machine to prevent fraud.

name: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY)
benefit: 35kg food grains per family per month at ₹2-₹3/kg
benefit_hindi: ₹2-₹3/किलो की दर पर प्रति परिवार 35 किलो अनाज

roadmap.title: Survey Inclusion
roadmap.description: Panchayat identifies the 'poorest of the poor' families for AAY.

roadmap.title: Issue of AAY Card
roadmap.description: A distinct color-coded Antyodaya Ration Card is issued.

roadmap.title: Visit FPS
roadmap.description: Visit the Ration shop monthly with the AAY card and Aadhaar.

roadmap.title: Pay Subsidy Rate
roadmap.description: Pay ₹3/kg for rice and ₹2/kg for wheat.

roadmap.title: Collect Quota
roadmap.description: Collect the flat 35kg allocation regardless of family size.

common_rejections: Family income is deemed too high during the Panchayat review.
Applicant is already holding a Priority Household (PHH) card instead.
tips: Widows, terminally ill persons, and disabled persons without support have priority for AAY.
Ensure the dealer gives the full 35kg; partial giving is illegal.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
benefit: Free tap water connection to every rural household
benefit_hindi: हर ग्रामीण घर को मुफ्त नल जल कनेक्शन

roadmap.title: Village Resolution
roadmap.description: Gram Sabha passes a resolution for water supply scheme implementation.

roadmap.title: Form Committee
roadmap.description: A Village Water and Sanitation Committee (VWSC) is formed.

roadmap.title: Apply for Connection
roadmap.description: Submit a request to the VWSC for a household Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC).

roadmap.title: Infrastructure Setup
roadmap.description: Govt lays pipes and builds overhead tanks.

roadmap.title: Tap Installation
roadmap.description: Tap is installed in your premises providing 55 liters per capita per day.

common_rejections: House is not technically feasible for piping without major restructuring.
Applicant is in an urban zone (scheme is rural only).
tips: The community must contribute a small percentage (cash/labor) to ensure ownership.
Report water quality issues directly to the VWSC.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Toilet)
benefit: ₹12,000 to build toilet at home
benefit_hindi: घर पर शौचालय बनाने के लिए ₹12,000

roadmap.title: Apply Online/Offline
roadmap.description: Submit application form at Gram Panchayat or via the SBM app.

roadmap.title: Block Verification
roadmap.description: Block officer visits to verify you do not already have a toilet.

roadmap.title: Start Construction
roadmap.description: Begin building the twin-pit toilet using your own funds temporarily.

roadmap.title: Geo-tagging
roadmap.description: Officer clicks a photo of the completed toilet with you for geo-tagging.

roadmap.title: Payment Release
roadmap.description: ₹12,000 incentive is transferred directly to your bank account.

common_rejections: House already has a functional toilet.
Construction does not meet the prescribed twin-pit standards.
tips: Do not build a septic tank; the scheme promotes twin-pit pour-flush toilets.
Take clear photos at different stages of construction just in case.

name: Saubhagya Yojana (Free Electricity)
benefit: Free electricity connection for poor households
benefit_hindi: गरीब घरों के लिए मुफ्त बिजली कनेक्शन

roadmap.title: Check Camps
roadmap.description: Look out for DISCOM camps set up in your village.

roadmap.title: Submit KYC
roadmap.description: Provide Aadhaar and BPL card to the DISCOM officer.

roadmap.title: On-spot Registration
roadmap.description: Officers do paperless registration via web app on the spot.

roadmap.title: Line Extension
roadmap.description: Wiring is pulled from the nearest electric pole to your home.

roadmap.title: Meter Installation
roadmap.description: Meter, LED bulb, and mobile charging point are installed for free.

common_rejections: Household already has a registered electricity connection.
Non-BPL families applying for free (they must pay ₹500 in 10 EMIs).
tips: Only the connection is free; you still have to pay the monthly electricity consumption bill.
If your area is entirely off-grid, a solar power pack is provided instead.

name: Mid-Day Meal Scheme
benefit: Free hot cooked meals to school children daily
benefit_hindi: स्कूली बच्चों को रोज मुफ्त गरम भोजन

roadmap.title: Enroll Child
roadmap.description: Admit the child in Class 1 to 8 in a Govt/Govt-aided school.

roadmap.title: Auto-Inclusion
roadmap.description: No separate application needed; all attending students are covered.

roadmap.title: Attend School
roadmap.description: Child attends school on working days.

roadmap.title: Meal Service
roadmap.description: Hot cooked meal meeting specific nutritional norms is served during break.

roadmap.title: Food Security Allowance
roadmap.description: If meal isn't served on a given day, an allowance must be paid.

common_rejections: Child is enrolled in a private, unaided school.
tips: Parents have the right to inspect the kitchen and taste the food quality.
The scheme is now officially known as PM POSHAN.

name: ICDS - Integrated Child Development Services
benefit: Free nutrition, health checkups, pre-school education for kids under 6
benefit_hindi: 6 वर्ष से कम बच्चों को मुफ्त पोषण, स्वास्थ्य जांच, प्री-स्कूल शिक्षा

roadmap.title: Locate Anganwadi
roadmap.description: Find the Anganwadi Centre assigned to your ward/village.

roadmap.title: Register Child
roadmap.description: Register the child with the Anganwadi Worker (AWW).

roadmap.title: Growth Monitoring
roadmap.description: Take the child for regular weighing to track malnutrition.

roadmap.title: Collect Ration/Meals
roadmap.description: Receive Take-Home Ration (THR) or hot meals based on age.

roadmap.title: Pre-School Ed
roadmap.description: Send children aged 3-6 daily for non-formal pre-school learning.

common_rejections: Child crosses 6 years of age (they should transition to standard school).
tips: Pregnant and lactating mothers can also receive nutritional support here.
Make sure the child's immunization schedule is recorded by the Anganwadi worker.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Yojana
benefit: Skill training and self-employment support for urban poor
benefit_hindi: शहरी गरीबों के लिए कौशल प्रशिक्षण और स्वरोजगार सहायता

roadmap.title: Join SHG
roadmap.description: Form or join an urban Self Help Group via community organizers.

roadmap.title: Skill Training
roadmap.description: Enroll in free skill placement programs tailored for urban markets.

roadmap.title: Apply for SEP
roadmap.description: Apply for Self Employment Programme loan (up to ₹2 Lakh for individuals).

roadmap.title: Bank Processing
roadmap.description: Banks process loan applications with interest subvention up to 7%.

roadmap.title: Setup Enterprise
roadmap.description: Start your micro-enterprise with ongoing support from the mission.

common_rejections: Applicant lives outside municipal limits (rural).
Credit history issues prevent bank loan approval.
tips: Applying as a group (SHG) increases the loan limit to ₹10 Lakhs.
Street vendors get special ID cards and vending zones under this scheme.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
benefit: ₹15,000 toolkit + ₹3 lakh loan + skill training for artisans
benefit_hindi: कारीगरों के लिए ₹15,000 टूलकिट + ₹3 लाख लोन + कौशल प्रशिक्षण

roadmap.title: CSC Registration
roadmap.description: Visit a CSC with Aadhaar and register as one of 18 traditional trades.

roadmap.title: Three-tier Verification
roadmap.description: Gram Panchayat, District, and State committees verify your artisan status.

roadmap.title: Receive ID
roadmap.description: Get PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID card.

roadmap.title: Basic Training
roadmap.description: Attend 5-day training; receive ₹500/day stipend and ₹15,000 toolkit grant.

roadmap.title: Avail Loan
roadmap.description: Apply for 1st tranche loan of ₹1 Lakh at 5% interest.

common_rejections: Trade does not fall under the 18 specific traditional crafts recognized.
Applicant or spouse is in government service.
tips: Do digital transactions to get ₹1 per transaction cashback (max 100/month).
Repay the first ₹1 Lakh loan on time to unlock the second ₹2 Lakh tranche.

name: Free Coaching for SC/ST/OBC
benefit: Free coaching for competitive exams (UPSC, banking, etc.)
benefit_hindi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं के लिए मुफ्त कोचिंग

roadmap.title: Find Institute
roadmap.description: Check the portal for empanelled institutes offering your desired course.

roadmap.title: Online Application
roadmap.description: Apply online during the window (usually twice a year).

roadmap.title: Merit Selection
roadmap.description: Selection is based on Class 12th/Degree marks merit.

roadmap.title: Enroll
roadmap.description: Join the coaching center physically. Course fees are paid directly to them.

roadmap.title: Stipend
roadmap.description: Receive monthly stipend (₹4000 local/₹6000 outstation) for expenses.

common_rejections: Applicant's family income exceeds ₹8 Lakh (recent update, check limits).
Applicant has already availed coaching under this scheme previously.
tips: Maintain high attendance; stipends are cut if attendance drops below thresholds.
You can only avail this scheme once in a lifetime.

name: PM Internship Scheme
benefit: ₹5,000/month stipend + ₹6,000 one-time grant for 1-year internship
benefit_hindi: 1 साल इंटर्नशिप के लिए ₹5,000/माह + ₹6,000 एकमुश्त

roadmap.title: Register on Portal
roadmap.description: Create a profile on pminternship.mca.gov.in using Aadhaar.

roadmap.title: Browse Opportunities
roadmap.description: Search for internship openings posted by top 500 partner companies.

roadmap.title: Apply & Interview
roadmap.description: Submit applications and clear the company's interview process.

roadmap.title: Join Internship
roadmap.description: Accept offer and begin 12-month training program.

roadmap.title: Receive Stipend
roadmap.description: ₹4500 is paid by Govt via DBT, ₹500 paid by company monthly.

common_rejections: Applicant comes from a family with a Govt employee.
Graduates from elite institutions (IIT/IIM/NLU) are excluded.
tips: Keep your skills profile updated on the portal to match with better companies.
You will get a one-time grant of ₹6,000 upon joining to cover relocation/setup.

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana
benefit: Free aids and assistive devices for senior citizens (BPL)
benefit_hindi: बीपीएल वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए मुफ्त सहायक उपकरण

roadmap.title: Look for Camps
roadmap.description: Wait for assessment camps organized by ALIMCO in your district.

roadmap.title: Medical Assessment
roadmap.description: Doctors at the camp assess vision, hearing, or motor disabilities.

roadmap.title: Submit Documents
roadmap.description: Provide Age proof (60+) and BPL proof at the camp.

roadmap.title: Device Manufacturing
roadmap.description: ALIMCO custom prepares devices (spectacles, hearing aids, wheelchairs).

roadmap.title: Distribution Camp
roadmap.description: Attend the follow-up distribution camp to receive your free device.

common_rejections: Applicant fails to prove BPL status or age (under 60).
Medical team deems the assistive device unnecessary.
tips: Devices get 1-year free maintenance from ALIMCO.
Keep an eye on local newspaper ads for camp dates in your district.
